newsitem.title: CHINA: China floods cut Shanghai, Fujian railway links.
newsitem.headline: China floods cut Shanghai, Fujian railway links.

text.p: Flooding in eastern China due to heavy rains over the past week has severed some railway links between the city of Shanghai and Fujian province, the official Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.
The flooding inundated stretches of railway beginning early on Friday, Xinhua said.

Train journeys from Shanghai to Fujian's major cities of Xiamen and Fuzhou were cancelled on Saturday, but workers had managed to repair damage to some of the flooded sections later that day, it said, quoting railway officials.
Workers have repaired damage to two of the three sections most seriously hit by flooding and services would resume on all lines within three to five days, the agency said.
Xinhua did not say how much freight and passenger traffic had been disrupted by the flooding.
Devastating floods caused by torrential rain across much of southern and eastern China have killed at least 85 people this month, state media and officials said on Friday.
